title: A game like civilization except you’re the CEO of a frontier lab. You have to race to ASI before your competitors without ending the fucking world! Free playable beta. Deep strategy. Made with Astra.
author: Short-Patient7772
selftext:
This game took dozens of passes so far, this is not a lazy one shot. Includes full story, music, 3D island laboratory, two separate tech trees (company and LLM), resource management, government relations, employee hiring, hundreds of moral dilemmas, 16 possible endings (even if you win you might cause the apocalypse), tongue-in-cheek black humor set to cell-shaded cartoon graphics and a cheery chiptune soundtrack!  
I have a lot more I want to add to this game. I am not close to done with it. But this is a playable beta and I wanted to see if people think it’s fun and get some feedback
